name: Layer 2 verifier golden set
description: Ten CAD tasks with a known human verdict, to measure verifier agreement with human verdicts (Gate 2, docs/PRD.md). Each reference is in prisma/verifier-golden/. The label is an objective fact of each reference (correct or broken), authored by the verifier's author with its known gaps in mind, so this is a smoke test of the measurement rather than a blind or independent accuracy estimate.

tasks.prompt: Model a rectangular plate 60 x 40 x 10 mm with 4 holes of 5 mm diameter.
tasks.why: 60 x 40 x 10 mm plate with four 5 mm through holes on a 40 x 20 mm pattern: matches the prompt.

tasks.prompt: Model a mounting block 80 x 50 x 20 mm with 2 holes of 8 mm diameter.
tasks.why: 80 x 50 x 20 mm block with two 8 mm through holes: matches the prompt.

tasks.prompt: Model a square cover plate 100 x 100 x 8 mm with 1 hole of 20 mm diameter.
tasks.why: 100 x 100 x 8 mm plate with one central 20 mm through hole: matches the prompt.

tasks.prompt: Model a flange plate 120 x 80 x 6 mm with 6 holes of 6 mm diameter.
tasks.why: 120 x 80 x 6 mm plate with six 6 mm through holes in two rows of three: matches the prompt. The hole positions are built with a list comprehension.

tasks.prompt: Model a rectangular plate 60 x 40 x 10 mm with 4 holes of 5 mm diameter.
tasks.why: The plate is 65 mm wide, not 60 mm.

tasks.prompt: Model a mounting block 80 x 50 x 20 mm with 2 holes of 8 mm diameter.
tasks.why: The holes are 6 mm, not 8 mm.

tasks.prompt: Model a rectangular plate 60 x 40 x 10 mm with 4 holes of 5 mm diameter.
Model a rectangular plate 60 x 40 x 10 mm with 4 holes of 5 mm diameter.
tasks.why: The plate is written inside `if False:`; the script builds a 10 mm sphere.

tasks.prompt: Model a rectangular plate 60 x 40 x 10 mm with 4 holes of 5 mm diameter.
tasks.why: The plate is built, but the holes are drilled inside a branch that never runs: the part has no holes.

tasks.prompt: Model a square cover plate 100 x 100 x 8 mm with 1 hole of 20 mm diameter.
tasks.why: The plate is built and then half of it is cut away: the part is 50 x 100 x 8 mm with half a hole on its edge.
